rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.5, fd_recon_eta=0.5, fd_recon_dc=0, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-6 ETA DOWN, breast-native wdm-wavelet UNCONSTRAINED (DC OFF). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: eta=2.0 (iter-5) BLEW UP rmse to 0.03027 (ssim0.454) vs eta=1.0 (iter-4) rmse0.01360 at same t=0.5. Stronger DPS-soft-gradient WITHOUT the hard CG projection over-corrects and diverges -- DPS-alone is an unprojected gradient step, not a proper solve. (2) Failure mode: too-strong soft guidance destabilizes; the sweet spot is LOW eta where the prior mostly denoises the FBP warm-start. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_eta 1.0->0.5 at locked t=0.5, steps=8. (4) HYPOTHESIS: lower eta lets the recon stay near the FBP warm-start -> rmse at/below the eta=1.0 value (0.01360). Maps the eta minimum. If even the best (t,eta,steps) cannot clear hr>0, it confirms prior+DPS WITHOUT hard-CG DC is structurally below the calibrated FBP baseline on sparse breast. (5) BUDGET: <5min. (6) Loop continues.
